Your privacy

This website stores information on your device. Some of it is needed for the pages to work. The rest runs only if you agree. You choose what to allow, and you can change your mind at any time. Privacy policy

What you allow

Delivers the pages and remembers the choice you make here. No third party is involved and none of it identifies you.

Apollo.io, a service of ZenLeads Inc. in the United States, receives your IP address and the pages you open, and matches the address against its own database of company networks. It tells us which companies read our work, not which people. It sets no cookies, but it stores an identifier in your browser.

Get Started

The Second Brain for Structural Engineering Firms

StructureOS brings your projects, standards and building codes into one system your engineers can ask in plain language.

Let's Talk

Your firm knows more than any one engineer can find.

The answer to today's question usually sits in a calculation from four years ago, in a checking engineer's note, or in a colleague's memory. Finding it often costs more than solving the problem again.

New engineers take months to learn the office standards. When experienced staff leave, what they knew leaves with them.

A second brain, in the AI sense

Capture
Calculations, reports, correspondence and project files go in as they are.
Ask
Engineers put a question in their own words. The answer comes back with the document it came from.
Connect
Projects, tasks and recorded hours sit alongside the documents they belong to.

Questions your engineers already ask

Today they ask a colleague, or they search. Both cost time, and both depend on who is in the room.

  • How did we solve punching shear on similar flat slabs, and what did the checking engineer note?
  • Which past projects had comparable soil conditions?
  • What does the uploaded guideline require for this connection detail?
  • How many hours did comparable projects take in the design phase?

Find what the firm knows, act on it, and keep it.

Every calculation, report and guideline your firm has produced becomes searchable by question.

  • Engineers ask in plain language and get answers from your own documents.
  • Every answer points to its source.
  • Uploaded building codes and guidelines are part of every answer.

Knowledge connects to the tools your team already uses to plan and track work.

  • Projects and tasks from your project management tool are linked to their documents.
  • Timesheet data shows what comparable work actually took.
  • Teams start new projects from proven solutions.

What your engineers learn stays with the firm.

  • New engineers learn office standards faster.
  • Experience remains available when senior staff leave.
  • Each project adds to what the next one can draw on.

What it connects to

Project management

Projects, tasks and their status, held against the documents they produced.

Timesheet tracking

Recorded hours per project, so comparable work can be measured against what it actually took.

Documents and guidelines

Standards, guidelines and internal rules, uploaded and drawn on in every answer.

See it against your own projects.

Tell us what your office has already produced and where your engineers lose time looking for it. We come back with an honest read on what would be worth building.
